summary: Whatcom County, WA 80' L-6 pole tower built 1949, trimmed to 50' with a 9x9 cab in 1957; staffed 1955-56 per WillhiteWeb; removed or destroyed about 1968; gated, permit-only access.

facts.design: 80-foot pole tower with L-6 cab (1949); trimmed to 50 feet with a 9x9 foot cab in 1957; separate ground cabin
facts.status_note: Tower and ground cabin removed or destroyed about 1968 per sources; the guide's undated photo captions show a footing

staffing.status: Lorna Anderson, a local and UW student, named as the lookout in 1955 and 1956 (WillhiteWeb, single source)

access.note: Summit privately owned; DNR owns parcels near the summit; the gate has permit signs and security patrol signs; WillhiteWeb says a permit can be obtained

visit.trail_note: Paved road from Acme on Mosquito Lake Road about 4 miles to a gate, then a hike of 6.4 miles one way with about 2,600 feet of gain

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Fire Lookout site give 3,350 ft (1,021 m); WillhiteWeb gives 3,356 ft on USGS and 3,361 ft on lidar. The brief's 1021.1 m matches the Register. Story reports the spread.
Register says removed about 1968; Fire Lookout site and WillhiteWeb say destroyed about 1968. The year agrees; only the wording differs.

notes_for_editor: Staffing rests on one source (WillhiteWeb naming Lorna Anderson for 1955 and 1956); no second source checked. The 1956-58 biennium line is a DNR report quoted on Forest Lookouts; the original was not read. Access rated permission because the guide describes permit and patrol signs at the gate; the guide's 'risk it' wording is not repeated and the story advises against passing the gate without permission. The guide's footing photos are undated. Brief record checked: status gone, registration April 23, 2012, and agency all match. One WebSearch returned only other Whatcom lookouts and a Bowman Mountain page; nothing cited from it. Page reads used: 6.
